fr: Malheur aux fraudeurs,
en: Woe to those who give less [than due],

ar: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكْتَالُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ
fr: qui, lorsqu’ils font mesurer pour eux-mêmes exigent la pleine mesure,
en: Who, when they take a measure from people, take in full.

fr: et qui lorsqu’eux-mêmes mesurent ou pèsent pour les autres, [leur] causent perte.
en: But if they give by measure or by weight to them, they cause loss.

fr: Ceux-là ne pensent-ils pas qu’ils seront ressuscités,
en: Do they not think that they will be resurrected

fr: en un jour terrible,
en: For a tremendous Day -

fr: le jour où les gens se tiendront debout devant le Seigneur de l’Univers ?
en: The Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of the worlds?

ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَـٰبَ ٱلْفُجَّارِ لَفِى سِجِّينٍ
fr: Non...! Mais en vérité le livre des libertins sera dans le Sijjîn.
en: No! Indeed, the record of the wicked is in sijjeen.

fr: et qui te dira ce qu’est le Sijjîn ? -
en: And what can make you know what is sijjeen?

fr: un livre déjà cacheté (achevé).
en: It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed.

fr: Malheur, ce jour-là, aux négateurs,
en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers,

fr: qui démentent le jour de la Rétribution.
en: Who deny the Day of Recompense.

ar: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
fr: Or, ne le dément que tout transgresseur, pécheur :
en: And none deny it except every sinful transgressor.
tr: Wama yukaththibu bihi illakullu muAAtadin atheem

ar: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَـٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
fr: qui, lorsque Nos versets lui sont récités, dit : "[Ce sont] des contes d’anciens !"
en: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples."
tr: Itha tutla AAalayhi ayatunaqala asateeru al-awwaleen

ar: كَلَّا ۖ بَلْ ۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
fr: Pas du tout, mais ce qu’ils ont accompli couvre leurs cœurs .
en: No! Rather, the stain has covered their hearts of that which they were earning.
tr: Kalla bal rana AAalaquloobihim ma kanoo yaksiboon

ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ عَن رَّبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَّمَحْجُوبُونَ
fr: Qu’ils prennent garde ! En vérité ce jour-là un voile les empêchera de voir leur Seigneur,
en: No! Indeed, from their Lord, that Day, they will be partitioned.

fr: ensuite, ils brûleront certes, dans la Fournaise;
en: Then indeed, they will [enter and] burn in Hellfire.

ar: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
fr: on [leur] dira alors : "Voilà ce que vous traitiez de mensonge !"
en: Then it will be said [to them], "This is what you used to deny."
tr: Thumma yuqalu hatha allatheekuntum bihi tukaththiboon

ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَـٰبَ ٱلْأَبْرَارِ لَفِى عِلِّيِّينَ
fr: Qu’ils prennent garde ! Le livre des bons sera dans 'Illiyûn -
en: No! Indeed, the record of the righteous is in ʿilliyyūn.

fr: et qui te dira ce qu’est 'Illiyûn ?
en: And what can make you know what is ʿilliyyūn?

fr: un livre cacheté !
en: It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed

fr: Les rapprochés (d’Allah : les Anges) en témoignent.
en: Which is witnessed by those brought near [to Allāh].

fr: Les bons seront dans [un jardin] de délice,
en: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure

fr: sur les divans, ils regardent.
en: On adorned couches, observing.

fr: Tu reconnaîtras sur leurs visages, l’éclat de la félicité.
en: You will recognize in their faces the radiance of pleasure.

fr: On leur sert à boire un nectar pur, cacheté,
en: They will be given to drink [pure] wine [which was] sealed.

ar: خِتَـٰمُهُۥ مِسْكٌ ۚ وَفِى ذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلْمُتَنَـٰفِسُونَ
fr: laissant un arrière-goût de musc. Que ceux qui la convoitent entrent en compétition [pour l’acquérir]
en: The last of it is musk. So for this let the competitors compete.

fr: Il est mélangé à la boisson de Tasnîm ,
en: And its mixture is of Tasneem,

fr: source dont les rapprochés boivent.
en: A spring from which those near [to Allāh] drink.

ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ كَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يَضْحَكُونَ
fr: Les criminels riaient de ceux qui croyaient,
en: Indeed, those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed.
tr: Inna allatheena ajramoo kanoomina allatheena amanoo yadhakoon

fr: et, passant près d’eux, ils se faisaient des œillades,
en: And when they passed by them, they would exchange derisive glances.

ar: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُوا۟ فَكِهِينَ
fr: et, retournant dans leurs familles, ils retournaient en plaisantant,
en: And when they returned to their people, they would return jesting.

ar: وَإِذَا رَأَوْهُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ
fr: et les voyant, ils disaient : "Ce sont vraiment ceux-là les égarés."
en: And when they saw them, they would say, "Indeed, those are truly lost."

fr: Or, ils n’ont pas été envoyés pour être leurs gardiens.
en: But they had not been sent as guardians over them.

ar: فَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ
fr: Aujourd’hui, donc, ce sont ceux qui ont cru qui rient des infidèles.
en: So Today those who believed are laughing at the disbelievers,

fr: sur les divans, ils regardent.
en: On adorned couches, observing.

ar: هَلْ ثُوِّبَ ٱلْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ
fr: Est-ce que les infidèles ont eu la récompense de ce qu’ils faisaient ?
en: Have the disbelievers [not] been rewarded [this Day] for what they used to do?
